later.verbatim: I think ascension is not fun, lets remove it. The other game does it by having various buildings/npcs on each island that request certain items(you select from menu) that unlock new recipes.

Also we dont need to complete ALL requests on each island to move to the next. We unlock islands by paying certain resources to unlock a bridge(ideally some magical altar at the north part of the map that locks final island and paying tribute there unlocks each bridge(tribute consists of 5 different items per island, each requiring 5-20 of the item to make automation a reliable way to get them). Each npc unlocks: New building that produces something new/related to the island. utility(such as another part of automation)
